name: Bigtooth Aspen
desc: Bigtooth Aspen (Populus grandidentata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Populus grandidentata, commonly called large-tooth aspen, big-tooth aspen, American aspen, Canadian poplar, or white poplar, is a deciduous tree native to eastern North America.
